question: Should OpenClaw core accept this stacked `includeFamily` plus default-off `sessionFamilyCarryover` design, including archived reset summaries crossing the model-provider boundary when explicitly enabled?
rationale: The code path appears bounded and tested, but the PR changes public protocol/tool/config surfaces and session-state/provider-boundary semantics that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Approve stacked opt-in design
options.body: Land #90239 or otherwise approve its family-history API first, then merge this PR after exact-head checks confirm the current stack.

options.title: Split history from carryover
options.body: Land only the `includeFamily` retrieval path now and require a narrower follow-up for automatic prompt carryover policy.

options.title: Pause provider-boundary carryover
options.body: Keep or close this PR if maintainers do not want archived reset context entering model-bound prompts even behind an experimental opt-in.

recommendation.title: Approve stacked opt-in design
recommendation.body: Land #90239 or otherwise approve its family-history API first, then merge this PR after exact-head checks confirm the current stack.
